minegishi2016.analysis_limits: Bonferroni intragroup posthoc after interaction and separate t-tests; no demonstrated global endpoint-family control. Small sample, no prospective protocol/hierarchy recovered; nonsignificance not equivalence.
minegishi2016.reporting_conflicts: Abstract/Discussion/conclusion assert improved muscle strength/mass/performance from active within-arm gains despite controlled chair/strength/CSA nulls. Discussion itself admits physical performance cannot be distinguished from light exercise alone, then suggests distinguishability; retain null comparisons and MFCV positive.
minegishi2016.safety: No adverse events or tablet-related side effects reported in all 22 over 10 weeks; event ascertainment/count table and long-term/pediatric safety unavailable.
minegishi2016.funding_conflicts: All authors Kao-affiliated and internal ethics; Acknowledgments contains technical contributors but no explicit funding/COI declaration in this original main. Do not invent outside funding or absence of financial relationship.
minegishi2016.disposition: Preparation-specific human EMG-support context with controlled function/strength/CSA counterevidence, not an extra controlled strength/performance win.
